Elaine: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the people plan. opening a short thread for logistics q's only.
Sophie: thanks! first: which teams get immediate greenlights for hires?
Jamal: runtime and infra get first pass. we'll also approve a couple devex roles if internal transfers don't fill gaps.
Sophie: are manager slots included or all ICs?
Jamal: mainly senior ICs. manager reqs are exceptional and need hiring committee sign-off.
Praveen: if my team is split across pods, who owns oncall during the handoff?
Elaine: original rotations stay for two weeks; managers will post overlap/shadow schedules if we reassign.
Maria: heads: please send 1-paragraph role briefs by Friday EOD. I can open up to 8 reqs for Q3 and will triage.
Praveen: process for internal transfers?
Elaine: informal chat with current + receiving managers, then file internal transfer form (link to be posted). recruiting prioritizes transfers for matching reqs.
Recruiter-bot: Reminder set: submit role briefs by Fri EOD -> #all-hands
Sophie: timeline for org map publish?
Elaine: draft Wed, feedback Thu-Fri, final next Mon. we'll include reporting lines and suggested overlap owners.
Maria: I'll host a 30-min sync Thu to review briefs. please come with names if you already have internal candidates.
Elaine: thanks all, closing thread for now — will reopen if more follow-ups come in. :handshake:
